messages:
maya: Quick ping — I opened a PR to attach an egress route for the new GPU subnet in us-west-2. Need one infra approval to merge during tonight's canary window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/1892 :eyes:
sam: Which region/route table is this touching?
maya: us-west-2, route table `rtb-0a1b2c3d` (gpu-subnet-egress). Only adds `aws_route.gpu_egress` resource. Plan looks clean.
lee: can you paste the plan snippet?
maya: ```
# terraform plan -target=aws_route.gpu_egress
+ aws_route.gpu_egress
  cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.gpu_igw.id
```
maya: It's a single new route, no replacement of existing routes. Will deploy with `-auto-approve` in canary window if approved.
dev-ci-bot: PR checks: plan ok, fmt ok, ci/integration passed :white_check_mark:
olivia: what's the rollback plan if traffic flaps?
maya: fallback: we have a route priority and healthcheck on the IGW; can revert with `terraform apply -replace=aws_route.gpu_egress` or remove the route. Also can failover to natgw via routing policy if needed.
sam: I'll take a look in ~25m, ping me if you want me to prioritize.
lee: one suggestion—add `tags = { environment = "canary" team = "infra" }` to the resource, and add you as owner in the PR description.
maya: will add tags + update PR desc now. thx!
sam: LGTM once tags added. Approving now. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks — merging after 2:00am PT canary window. I'll post status here when done. :rocket:
